issues.description: Method signature mismatch for SealSaloon.checkOrderReady: The problem statement (UML and task text) requires a no-argument method checkOrderReady() that the orderMeal implementation should call. The reference solution instead declares checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging) (signature found in solution file). This difference in parameter list (no-arg vs one boolean parameter) creates a contradiction between the specification and the provided solution and may confuse students or tests that expect the zero-argument method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the problem specification by adding a no-argument overload or replacing the existing method: add `public void checkOrderReady()` that delegates to the current implementation (for example, `checkOrderReady(true)` or `checkOrderReady(false)`), or change the existing signature to `public void checkOrderReady()` and keep any logging behind an internal flag. Alternatively, if the boolean parameter is intentional, update the problem statement/UML to document the parameter so the specification and solution align.
